greetingInitial: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: the first of eight official static reaction stickers for the Korean creative-work service DDONA. Create a NEW greeting/waving sticker using the attached favicon only as a brand-symbol reference. The main character IS the pink double ㄷ (ㄸ) speech-bubble mark: two side-by-side thick squared-open-right pink strokes, rounded outer corners, straight squared stroke endings, with the original lower-left triangular speech tail. Preserve that silhouette and exact recognizable two-part mark; do not make a human, animal, unrelated mascot, or change it into a rounded single bubble. Remove the favicon's dark rounded background plate entirely. Anthropomorphize the mark with one friendly face spanning the two openings (tiny dark eyes with pale-cream eye/face areas that remain legible on both dark and light UI) and simple small pink cartoon arms/hands. Gesture: a clear friendly raised waving hand, relaxed other hand, welcoming gentle smile. Pink #fb6ca0 and dark charcoal details; flat clean smooth 2D illustration, minimal linework, a subtle pale outline only where necessary for dark/light legibility, no texture, no 3D, no heavy shadow. One single centered character, square composition, ample consistent transparent padding, all gestures inside frame. Actual transparent background with alpha; no white or dark plate, no scene, no checkerboard. No text, no Korean letters beyond the geometric brand symbol, no slogan, no logo caption, no watermark. Designed to read clearly at 128 CSS px.
greetingLegibilityEdit: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit only the facial details and the tiny hand-waving motion marks of this greeting sticker for legibility on very dark UI. Keep the exact pink double-open-square ㄸ speech-bubble character silhouette, pink color, hands, wave gesture, lower-left speech tail, feet, composition, proportions, and transparent background unchanged. Add a clearly visible but delicate pale warm-cream outline/keyline around both dark eyes and the dark smile and the two dark waving marks, so those details remain recognizable when the transparent sticker is placed on #0d0d0d. The center remains dark charcoal and the outline should also remain legible against light backgrounds; use a crisp high-contrast two-tone treatment, not blurry glow or shadow. No background plate. No new objects, lettering, text, or watermark. Preserve alpha and transparency. This is a targeted accessibility improvement only.
